description: Screen a person or company name against the official NIGSAC (Nigeria Sanctions Committee) list of Nigerian designations — both individuals and entities. Returns CLEAR or POTENTIAL_MATCH with candidates and similarity scores. Best-effort FUZZY name matching (diacritic-folded, transliteration-tolerant); it over-flags on purpose and is a screening signal for human review, NOT a legal determination or your sole compliance control. Scope: the NIGERIAN list only — a CLEAR result does not mean the subject is unsanctioned elsewhere (the UN consolidated list is not screened here). Default data source is the LIVE NIGSAC register; set SANCTIONS_PROVIDER=mock for an offline synthetic stub. Example: { name: 'Ibrahim Test Doe' }.

name.description: Person or company name to screen

name: screen_sanctions

listVersion.description: Version/date of the list snapshot screened against, where known

matches.description: Candidate matches, highest similarity first; empty when CLEAR

listType.description: Which list the entry sits on, e.g. "NIGSAC UNSC" / "NIGSAC domestic"; null when unknown

name.description: Listed name that the query matched against

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was fetched

status.description: CLEAR = no candidate matches; POTENTIAL_MATCH = review the matches

title: Screen a name against Nigerian sanctions lists
